# Cap tables, line by line

It's worth noting that a cap table is only as useful as it is current. Let's dive in.

A cap table lists every security the company has issued. For Acme, that meant 8,000,000 common shares for the founders, a 10% option pool and one SAFE.

The bottom line: update it after every grant. See [the MDX follow-up](/posts/linking-post) for option pools.
